ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a contiguous low-intensity black mass. High-contrast white mottling is localized at the distal tip of the right lobe. Sparse, small-diameter high-intensity focal spots (white points) are scattered across the central and upper-left regions of the fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 45-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations throughout the continuous boundary; specifically, a sequence of jagged peaks and valleys is visible along the superior margin of the left lobe and the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a convex curve on the lateral sections transitioning to a sharp concave trajectory toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white clusters located on the distal tip of the right lobe and several smaller circular scars along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, unaligned linear white pixel streaks (rake marks) forming a wide 'V' or 'X' pattern on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular cluster of high-intensity material (barnacle colonization and possible organic debris) localized on the far left tip of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct diagonal scarring pattern on the left lobe consisting of three parallel high-contrast linear marks.
